Your team

Within the The Aviation Transformation Directorate, you will join the Centre of Expertise (CoE). The Data Scientist Assistant supports the team's activities by analysing and preparing data, contributing to machine learning and AI solutions, and transforming data into actionable insights through visualisations, reports and presentations to support innovation and operational decision-making.

Your role

Your role will be to:

- Provide specialized support in the design, development, validation and deployment of machine learning models (supervised/unsupervised methods, feature engineering, model evaluation, optimisation).
- Provide specialized support in the design, development and deployment of solutions using Large Language Models, including prompt engineering, fine‑tuning or adaptation, embeddings, and/or Retrieval‑Augmented Generation.
- Assist in extracting, processing, cleaning and verifying structured and unstructured data from multiple sources, ensuring data quality and supporting analysis, machine learning activities and reporting.
- Support the conduct of exploratory and statistical analyses using data, drawing insights and/or making predictions to improve operations.
- Support the maintenance and updating of databases and data repositories and contribute to the provision of data for model training, dashboards, reports and ad-hoc analyses.
- Contribute to scientific papers, prepare materials for scientific conferences, meetings, workshops, presentations, etc. under the guidance of more experienced staff.
- Stay up to date with trends in data science such as modelling, algorithms and tools, and share knowledge within the Agency’s relevant communities.
- Support and train less experienced data scientist / analysts assistants.
- Carry out any other task in line with the main purpose of the job.

Required qualifications, experience & competencies

- Candidates must fulfil the following educational and professional experience requirements:
- - Completion of post-Secondary education in a relevant field meeting European Qualifications Framework (EQF) Level 5 or higher followed by at least 5 years’ relevant experience applying machine-learning techniques and/or data analysis. At least two years of experience should be in the aviation domain (e.g. air traffic management, network management, flight operations).
- As an asset: the completion of third level studies meeting European Qualifications Framework (EQF) Level 6 in a relevant domain (e.g. Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics).

- Internal candidates can check on the intranet to see what level of in-house experience is considered equivalent to educational qualifications where appropriate.
- Understanding of a range of machine learning techniques in supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement learning, and awareness of their real-world advantages and limitations.
- Scripting and programming skills, with mandatory proficiency in Python.
- The following technical skills and experience would be desirable:
- Experience with relational (SQL) and NoSQL databases.
- Experience working in a Cloud environment, especially Microsoft’s Azure.
- Experience with data-visualisation tools (especially Power BI), or Python’s visualisation libraries.
- Experience of using AI tools for data science and daily non-technical tasks.
- Proficiency in mathematics, including statistics (distributions, testing, regression).
- Knowledge or experience of validation methods applied in aviation concepts.

- Communication: You are able to foster two-way communication.
- Planning and Organisation: You know how to plan ahead and adapt as required.
- Analytical Thinking: You apply a methodical approach to complex information.
- Creativity & Innovation: You are able to develop new methods and foster an innovative climate.
- Results focus: You seek to improve personal performance.
- Ability to work in a multinational and multicultural environment.
- Professional conduct in line with the corporate behaviours of the Agency, i.e. result-driven, readiness to change, customer focus, integrity and team-player approach.
- The working languages of the Agency are English and French. For this particular job, candidates must be proficient users of English at level C1. The selected candidate will be required to become basic users of French at level A2 before the end of the probation period.The levels relate to the European-framework-reference Common European Framework of References for languages (CEFR).

This appointment may be renewed several times, but its total duration, including all renewal periods, may not exceed nine (9) years. A conversion to an undetermined duration appointment is possible where all of the following cumulative conditions are met: the post is confirmed as being of a lasting nature; the staff member has completed at least five years of service; the staff member’s performance has been satisfactory; and the conversion is in the interests of the service. Your team

Within the The Aviation Transformation Directorate, the EUROCONTROL Innovation Hub (EIH) carries out research, innovation and simulation activities to help improve European aviation performance, safety and sustainability, bridging the gap between R&D; and operations. The EIH also addresses emerging new technologies as well as deployment of drones and urban air mobility systems.

You will contribute to the coordination between research projects and simulation platform teams by collecting and consolidating operational requirements, supporting their translation into technical solutions, and assisting in the testing and validation of these solutions within the simulation platforms.

Your role

Your role will be to:

- Support the technical interface between research projects and the team responsible for the development of the simulation platform and identify and consolidate the operational requirements related to system evolution.
- In cooperation with the team responsible for the development of the simulation platform, contribute to the required platform enhancements and assist in translating them into technical requirements and change requests, while subsequently ensuring their proper implementation.
- Organise, validate, and manage data for testing, simulation, and analysis to support accurate and effective simulation platforms evaluations.
- Assist in configuring, testing, and deploying simulation platforms and associated tools updates and migrations, ensuring readiness and acceptance by project users, addressing any identified issues.
- Participate in validation exercises conducted as part of research projects, help ensure the smooth running of the simulation platform’s technical operations, assist in managing platform-related issues and contribute to the identification and implementation of corrective actions where required.
- Actively contribute to meetings and debriefing sessions related to validation exercises, including the sharing of lessons learned on the technical aspects.
- Develop and maintain technical documentation, including test scenarios and reports, and provide regular reports to project managers on activities performed, providing actionable insights and updates.
- Assist in the development of new tools, methodologies, and workflows to enhance testing efficiency, simulation platforms quality, and overall productivity.
- Provide technical support and training to users of the simulation platforms and tools, responding to inquiries and guiding them in using their features.
- Contribute to training materials and conduct presentations as needed to support end-users and internal teams.
- Develop knowledge and skills in field of expertise under the guidance of more senior staff.
- Carry out any other task in line with the main purpose of the job.

- Post secondary education in a relevant domain (e.g. Computer Science, (Aerospace) Engineering or any other related field), meeting European Qualifications Framework (EQF) Level 5 or higher followed by a minimum of five years of relevant professional experience in engineering activities, at least 3 of them in Air Traffic Management domain.

- Internal candidates can check on the intranet to see what level of in-house experience is considered equivalent to educational qualifications where appropriate.
- Experience in the identification and collection of users’ needs, and in defining corresponding technical software specifications.
- Good knowledge in ATM operations (specifically in ATC and Network Management operations).
- Experience in ATM simulation platforms (e.g. INNOVE, NMVP, ESCAPE, eDEP, PLANTA, ….).
- Knowledge in software verification and validation.
- Experience in SESAR and R&I; projects in the last 3 years.
- Ability to identify, analyse and resolve technical issues and present them clearly and effectively.

- Knowledge of Linux, virtual and cloud environment, shell scripting.

Your team

Within the The Aviation Transformation Directorate, the simulation validation Assistant will join the Centre of Expertise (CoE) and provide specialised support in the validation of new Air Transport concepts through operational simulations, focusing on planning, executing, analysing, and reporting validation activities within innovation programmes.

Your role

Your role will be to:

- Provide specialised support for validation activities for Air Transport operational simulations related to the Innovation Programmes activities.
- Develop validation plans including objectives, validation exercise arrangements, scenarios, conditions, success criteria, metrics and data-collection materials.
- Contribute to validation/simulation preparation and operational and technical readiness activities, including platforms and tool checks, dry runs, and preparing training and briefings material.
- Support the conduct of validation exercises through structured observations, questionnaires, interviews and debriefings; monitor adherence to the agreed methodology and experimental design.
- Prepare, clean, structure and document quantitative and qualitative datasets; perform descriptive and preliminary analyses; identify relevant trends and anomalies and produce clear data visualisations.
- Analyse and interpret validation exercises results with subject matters experts and relevant specialists, and formalise and consolidate these results, conclusions and recommendations in technical notes, validation reports and presentations.
- Contribute to the improvement and consistent application of validation methods, templates and tools, including established quality assurance and standardisation practices.
- Carry out tasks according to the established methodology and experimental design and report any detected issues or anomalies.
- Share practical knowledge, tools and good practices with colleagues, assist and/or support staff with less experience in the domain of expertise/knowledge.
- Develop knowledge and skills in the field of expertise under the guidance of more senior staff.
- Carry out any other tasks in line with the main purpose of the job.

Required qualifications, experience & competencies

- Candidates must fulfil the following educational and professional experience requirements:

- Completion of post-Secondary education in a relevant field meeting European Qualifications Framework (EQF) Level 5 or higher followed by at least 5 years’ relevant professional experience.

- Internal candidates can check on the intranet to see what level of in-house experience is considered equivalent to educational qualifications where appropriate.
- Experience in applying validation methods, human-centred methodologies and experimental design approaches (e.g. EOCVM, design thinking).
- Experience in preparing, supporting and monitoring the execution of validation exercises such as Real Time Simulations (RTS), Fast Time Simulations (FTS), gaming, prototyping.
- Experience in descriptive and statistical analysis of data.
- Experience in using data-analysis and visualisation tools, such as Excel, Power BI, Tableau, R, Python or equivalent tools.
- Experience in Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) techniques and their application in validation and simulation exercises.
- Experience in Air Traffic Management or Air Transport.
- Knowledge on human factors assessments methods and human factors techniques.
- Technical drafting and presenting skills (English).
- The following are considered assets:
- Experience in advanced statistical analysis.
- Experience in task analysis, usability evaluation, or UI/UX research.
- Experience with EUROCONTROL or equivalent operational simulation platforms (e.g. ESCAPE, eDEP, …).
